answer: Because the jade weight is recomputed from the ledge history each close, the crystal audit makes public the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for each duplicate self, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 6 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 39% of full weight. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
